# RenderSettings

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/components/render_settings.h`](../../../src/logic/components/render_settings.h) · Scene / prefab name: `null` · Described in `data/core.json`

Runtime toggles and parameters of the scene passes, edited from the debug menu and by the graphics level

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `terrain, grass, models, vegetation, animals` | `bool` | pass toggles (true) |
| `grass_pass` | `bool` | set by GrassPass: the terrain is dark under the grass |
| `tree_shade` | `float` | darkness under the plants (0.85) |
| `lighting` | `RenderSettings::Lighting[2]` | desktop (High), VR (Medium): tier, traced_range, sun_rays, plant_geometry_range, shadowed_torches, animals; Lighting::of(tier) |
| `far_plants_in_rays, far_plants_on_screen` | `bool` | far plants as boxes in the rays / drawn from their volume (true) |
| `probe_rays_per_frame` | `int` | 250000 |
| `rays_per_probe` | `int` | 48 |
| `textures` | `RenderSettings::Textures` | anisotropy of grass (16), ground, vegetation, animals (8), read when the passes are made |
| `streaming` | `RenderSettings::Streaming` | chunk_meshes, ray_chunks, plant_volume_slices a frame (8 each) |
| `soil` | `bool` | soil patches (true) |
| `soil_params` | `SoilParams` | the patches' noises |
| `scree` | `float` | stones at the foot of the rock (1) |
| `relief` | `float` | depth of the ground relief (1) |
| `vegetation_params` | `RenderSettings::Vegetation` | lod_bias 2, force_lod -1, normal_maps, subsurface, cull |
| `grass_params` | `RenderSettings::Grass` | base_normal, follow_terrain, tile_size, height, height_map, patch_amount, patch_size, noise, wind, layers, colour, dryness, curve, shadow, canopy, silhouette, azimuth_dither, baked_colour, species |

## Notes

Emplaced by the Renderer, which applies the Graphics level to it before the command line keys.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: CameraWalk, ClassicRender, Lights, PlantVolumes, ProbeVolume, RayScene, SoilMaps, Terrain, TreeShade, VRRender, animals, model, terrain, vegetation. Written by: DebugMenu, Renderer, grass. Created by: Renderer. Destroyed by: —.

## Side effects of those systems

- **[CameraWalk](../systems/CameraWalk.md)**
  - Log lines "CameraWalk : from x z heading ..." (plan), soil / herds scores, and each herd it turns to.
  - profile::message("CameraWalk : started") when the route is made and ("CameraWalk : finished") at the end: tools/profile_run.py --between cuts on them; DY_FRAME_NAMED("Walk") marks every frame of the walk; CPU zone "Route the walk".
  - Reads species geometry files through VegetationLibrary::loadSpecies / loadGeometry (once per species, main thread).
  - With "exit", ends the process at the end of the walk (Input::EXIT).
- **[ClassicRender](../systems/service-ClassicRender.md)**
  - GPU: command and descriptor pools, mapped uniform buffers, semaphores, query pool, capture buffer; records the desktop command buffer; acquires and presents swapchain images.
  - Log: gpu_times warnings and pass times every 300 frames and at each capture.
  - Profiler: CPU and GPU zones per pass (<pass> (desktop)), Sun rays / Composite (desktop).
- **[DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md)**
  - One ImGui window "Dynamical" (needs UI before it).
  - Changing the soil or grass height-map parameters makes SoilMaps / GrassPass bake their per-chunk maps again (they watch RenderSettings).
  - Creates torch entities and dynamic boxes (Jolt bodies through RigidBodySys) on button presses; destroys every PointLight entity on "No torches".
- **[Lights](../systems/service-Lights.md)**
  - Writes the mapped lights uniform buffer of the frame and sets Context::lights_buffers.
- **[PlantVolumes](../systems/service-PlantVolumes.md)**
  - Allocates three 3D images per baked species; records bake dispatches and mip blits into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Writes Context::plant_volumes (view set bindings 10 to 12).
  - Logs an info line per volume baked.
- **[ProbeVolume](../systems/service-ProbeVolume.md)**
  - Allocates pages of 3D probe textures (61 MB each, logged), uploads the brick table and the probe classes.
  - Records the probe dispatches into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Writes the Context probe pointers read by every view set; waits for the device when its buffer grows.
- **[RayScene](../systems/service-RayScene.md)**
  - Builds and refits acceleration structures in the frame's compute command buffer; allocates their buffers, scratch, geometry table and instance buffers.
  - Writes Context::tlas, ray_geometries and ray_textures, which every view set gets.
  - Connects onChunkGone to on_destroy<ChunkTriangles>; the destructor disconnects it and waits for the device.
- **[Renderer](../systems/service-Renderer.md)**
  - Creates the window, OpenXR session, Vulkan device and swapchain through Context.
  - Makes Lights, RayScene, ProbeVolume, PlantVolumes (with ray tracing), TreeShade, SoilMaps, ClassicRender, VRRender and the passes (SkyPass first, then the scene's renderer.passes).
  - GPU: per-frame fences and semaphores; one transfer, one compute and one graphics submission a frame; waits on the frame fence in prepare and on device idle in init and finish.
  - Threads: records both targets concurrently on the taskflow executor.
  - Log: 'Renderer : unknown pass <name>' (error).
  - Profiler zones: create lighting and targets, create pass / pipelines <name>, update <pass>, Update, Record, Submit.
- **[SoilMaps](../systems/service-SoilMaps.md)**
  - GPU: one RGBA8 2D array image of up to 2048 layers (about 37 MB), a layer upload (Transfer::updateImage) per chunk baked; sets Context::soil_view and soil_sampler.
  - CPU: SoilField::bake on the main thread, at most 16 re-bakes a frame after a parameter change.
- **[Terrain](../systems/Terrain.md)**
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin (throws when it is not 256 x 16 bytes) and ./resources/shaders/marchingcubes.comp.glsl.spv in init.
  - Allocates GPU memory: indirect buffer (2048 slots), staging ring (ring size x 8 chunks), lookup texel buffer, a 3 MB vertex buffer per slot (2^15 triangles x 3 vertices x 32 bytes, ray tracing usages when enabled), a readback buffer with ray tracing; descriptor pool and sets, compute pipeline.
  - Records into the compute command buffer of the frame: indirect resets, one dispatch per chunk, a clamp pass, with ray tracing copies of the indirect commands to the readback buffer; Tracy GPU zone "Marching cubes", CPU zone "Mesh chunks", plot "Chunks meshed".
  - Destroys the entities of chunks marked ChunkDestroying (all their components go with them).
  - Logs a warning "Terrain : out of chunk slots" when 2048 slots are used.
  - The destructor waits for the device to be idle and clears its components and TerrainBuffers.
- **[TreeShade](../systems/service-TreeShade.md)**
  - Signals: connects on_construct<Plant> and on_destroy<Plant> (disconnected in the destructor).
  - GPU: uploads a new 2048x2048 R8 image through Transfer whenever a plant came or went or the light moved (1 degree, 10 with ray tracing); old ones kept for the frames in flight; sets Context::tree_shade_view and tree_shade_sampler.
- **[VRRender](../systems/service-VRRender.md)**
  - Makes VRActions (which emplaces VRInput) even without a headset.
  - OpenXR: session begin / end / exit, xrWaitFrame (blocks), xrBeginFrame, xrEndFrame, eye swapchain images, view location.
  - GPU: per-frame and per-eye uniform buffers and descriptor sets, the headset command buffer.
  - Log: VR session started / stopped / lost, runtime shutting down.
  - Profiler: DY_FRAME_NAMED("Headset"), zones per pass and eye.
- **[animals](../systems/pass-animals.md)**
  - Loads species geometry and textures on taskflow workers; uploads buffers and textures.
  - Writes the skinning matrices of the frame into a mapped storage buffer per frame in flight.
  - With ray tracing records animal_skin.rt.comp.glsl dispatches into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Logs species loaded and failures, and a warning past 65536 joints in view.
- **[grass](../systems/pass-grass.md)**
  - Reads, or bakes and writes, ./resources/grass_raycast_<kind>.bin for the ten kinds of plants; uploads the ray textures (about 250 MB, less in blocks).
  - Uploads the species noise, a tile noise and the height map array.
  - Queues height map image updates for new chunks and up to 16 rebakes a frame after a parameter change.
  - Logs bake times and sizes; warns on an unknown grass_kind or an unwritable file.
  - Records up to three draws of each chunk's shell per target (stencil see through).
- **[model](../systems/pass-model.md)**
  - Allocates a descriptor set per material and an image view per texture.
  - Records the indexed draws of every model part into both targets.
- **[terrain](../systems/pass-terrain.md)**
  - Reads resources/textures/grass.png, rock.jpg and resources/ground/ground.json with its textures, uploads them as texture arrays.
  - Reads, or bakes and writes, ./resources/ground_relief_{mud,stones,sand}.bin and uploads the relief rays.
  - Decodes the ground textures as taskflow tasks and waits for them in the constructor.
  - Logs a warning without ground textures, an info line per relief baked.
  - Records one indirect draw per ready chunk into each target's command buffer.
- **[vegetation](../systems/pass-vegetation.md)**
  - Loads species geometry and textures on taskflow workers (silent_async, 6 at a time); uploads buffers and textures, allocates descriptor sets.
  - Logs each species loaded, errors for species and textures that fail.
  - With ray tracing gives meshes and textures to the rays (RayMeshes).
  - Records the plant draws and the far volume boxes of both targets; the destructor waits for running jobs.
